strings.en: Whew, I'm beat. One thing after another... What the hell is going on?
Hey, Joe. It's not break time yet, you know?
That's right, Big Bro. Once our units are resupplied,
they told us to collect the Einst wreckage, remember?
C'mon, what's the harm? Just a little while.
Thank you for your hard work, everyone.
Yeah, you too, Princess Romina!
I haven't done anything...
Should you lot be slacking off here?
What a noisy guy. I'm trying to rest here.
Noisy!? Who do you think you're talking to!?
Ugh, so noisy. I'd rather go pick up bones.
Let's go, Mike, Lenny.
I've still got a bit of maintenance left on the Blast Dragon...
Hm? Who's that?
Huh, so this is what the inside of the Elshank looks like?
What is all this commotion?
You are... Lady Allenby, I believe.
Y-yeah. That's me, but... being called "Lady" is kinda embarrassing...
Need something?
Hmm. I'm looking for Domon...
I saw him outside with Rain a little while ago.
Domon Kasshu was pretty down, huh...
At times like that, the best thing's getting comforted
by a knockout girlfriend like Rain.
Rain's Domon's girlfriend?
Isn't she? They're always together.
Just 'cause they're together doesn't make her his girlfriend, I think.
Exactly. Some dense guys never notice, even when they're together!
Wh-why're you looking at me!?
No reason~
...I see, we've both got it rough.
...Yeah, pretty much.
Huh? What are you girls talking about?
None of your business~
Yep, none of your business.
Geez, what's with those two? Suddenly all buddy-buddy.
The start of a beautiful female friendship.
Um... Lady Allenby, there's something I'd like to ask...
Yeah, what?
The princess believes this man called Schwarz may be the ninja.
Yeah. His moves really did look like Tobikage's.
Hmm. Come to think of it...
I heard there's a fighter who uses Germanic ninjutsu.
Germanic... ninjutsu?
Then is he the legendary ninja!?
Who knows?
If anyone who uses ninjutsu is a ninja, maybe he is,
but I can't say if he's the ninja from planet Radorio's legend.
I see...
Isn't that good, Princess Romina?
I thought the ninja's trail had gone completely cold at the Iga village,
but there's still a chance.
(...But only Joe and the others can pilot Radorio's royal machines.
What could this mean...?)
So this is where you were, Domon.
Domon?
Rain... I'm leaving on a training journey...
Training?
Because I was so green, I let the Devil Gundam revive.
If I'd been stronger, I could have saved my brother and Master...
Domon...
Got it. I'm coming too.
...You'd get in the way of my training. Stay on the Gandor.
Wha-! In the way!? Who do you think handles
the Shining Gundam's tuning and all!?
I'm part of the Shining Gundam's crew too, you know!
Domon.
All right...! Let's go... Rain.
W-wait a sec. We can't just leave on our own.
We have to tell Dr. Hazuki first...
The ones holding Jaburo... are this mystery army?
We're recovering the wreckage now. We'll learn something, Commander.
Who's out doing the work?
The resupplied mobile suit units, including Captain Amuro.
Just in case, the Getter Team's out too.
Big Bro headed out with Lenny a bit ago too.
Allenby tagged along too.
Hey, doesn't that sound fun? Let's go too, Banjo.
Beauty, this isn't a game.
Besides, how can you even want to go look at those creepy things?
Now, now, let's leave this to the Captain.
MS are definitely better suited to delicate work.
That's right.
Don't we have stuff of our own to take care of?
Ladies?
Mister's right. We've secured the skies over Jaburo,
but there's too much we don't know, like who the enemy is.
And we can't just ignore that Devil Gundam thing either.
Speaking of which, I haven't seen Domon around.
Mikamura contacted me. Kasshu and the others
are leaving the Gandor to pursue the Devil Gundam.
Right, they came here chasing the Devil Gundam to begin with.
Domon has to go after his brother and his master, doesn't he.
They'll pursue the Devil Gundam while training for a while.
They'll contact us as soon as they find it.
Whatever.
We came all this way, so let's just storm in, Commander Hazuki!
Koji, this is exactly when we need to act calmly!
It's the opposite. When you're on a roll, that's when you push all the way.
We've come this far. Now we can only go as far as we can.
Right, the situation on the ground is still far from good.
Commander, what's the plan for going in?
Now, wait. Analyzing the enemy comes first.
What a drag. Let's just get goin'.
Juzo, calm down.
No use rushin' it.
Hm, Chris? Commander Hazuki, the recovery team's calling.
Yes, put them through.
...Princess...?
Shaff... I have a bad feeling...
What is this light!? It's coming from outside!
Dammit, I can't see a thing! Was that some kind of explosion...!?
Big Bro! Lenny!
What, what!? What's going ooon!?
Ugh, light with no heat at all... Where's all this light coming from...!?
What's going on, an enemy attack!? Are the guys outside okay!?
No good, I can't keep my eyes open...!
If this is an enemy attack... Jun, get ready to sortie at once.
If they target this place, we're in trouble...!
Ngh... got it... Tetsuya.
What's happening outside...!?
If only I can safely reach... the rendezvous with the Commander...
Still, those two... so persistent... Why go that far?
Domon revived me, but it seems I must still build up more power...
But if I stay here, the Gandor Team will soon come after me.
Hm... Who's there!?
...A pleasure to make your acquaintance...
A crimson machine...? How did you get in here, girl?
...No, no ordinary girl. What do you want with me? Answer wisely...
The Gandor Team won't be coming anytime soon...
What...?
...I've sent that dragon off... to the rift between sea and land...
The rift between sea and land...?
I am on your side, you see...
Heh... What an amusing thing to say out of nowhere.
Do you think I'd so readily believe the words of some uncanny intruder?
...That is up to you...
...But have you forgotten how I helped you in that southern forest?
...Southern forest...? South America... Jaburo. Then, girl, you were the one?
Is it... over?
Dammit, my eyes are still flickering...!
Check the Gandor for damage. All personnel, stand by on deck!
What's the status of the mobile suit team doing recovery work?
Captain Amuro, Lieutenant Amada...! It's no use, they're not responding!
No, this can't be...
Sakurano? Don't tell me... something happened to Captain Amuro's team!?
What about Joe and Lenny!?
What's wrong, Mari? Don't tell me they all got blown away...
Mister...
Whoa, whoa, don't tell me...
No way... Big Bro, answer me! Lenny!
Joe...!
Are you saying they were all blown away...?
Could be a new enemy weapon...! Hazuki, this is bad...!
If that was an enemy attack...
then staying here is dangerous, Commander Hazuki.
But... we can't just abandon everyone outside!
No, that light just now... rather than a beam or an explosion...
it felt closer to a glow, like Raideen's.
I see, Raideen runs on the mysterious energy
of the ancient Mu Empire, doesn't it?
So that light was the work of some kind of supernatural power?
...Supernatural... Commander Hazuki, you said Show and the others
came from another world, didn't you?
Yes, from a place called Byston Well...
Could it be... they returned to their own world?
Whaaat! And dragged everyone else along!? No way!
Heh, probably... it's exactly that.
You're...
Todd... Guinness, was it? I see, you're from Byston Well.
Not quite.
Strictly speaking, I'm like Show: summoned from here to Byston Well.
...And that light just now looked a lot like when I was first summoned.
Which means...
There's almost no doubt...?
But everyone around them too? Isn't that way too many?
Did you forget what happened when I showed up in New York?
My whole unit got thrown onto the surface. Same thing.
Then Joe is... I mean, everyone is still safe?
Whew, what a relief.
Well, no way Joe or Lenny would kick the bucket that easily.
All their ID signals are gone too... All we can do is trust them.
Gah, what a pain! So they got an invite to some wonderland, huh?
But, y'know, getting flung into a place like that out of nowhere...
is Big Bro gonna be okay?
Show told me they've got a war going on over there too, right?
Hmm... Captain Amuro and Lieutenant Amada can take charge there,
and with the Getter Team there, they shouldn't fall behind. The problem is...
Us... right, Commander Hazuki?
Sanjo is right.
...We've missed our chance to storm Jaburo.
Talk about bad timing!
We came all this way, and all we can do is sit and watch!
Seriously. It's like it was all set up...
Don't tell me it's that mystery bunch holding Jaburo, or the Devil Gundam!?
After coming this far... can't we force our way in anyway?
Honestly, it'd be tough. Our forces are spread too thin...
We've lost most of our MS, so even long-range attacks
are hard to manage now, Jun.
You're right... How did it come to this...?
What do we do now, Commander?
We're getting a request for help from the Far East Branch!
Now of all times...
No, we were planning to return to the Cyber Beast Force base anyway...
True, we should head back once to regroup...
Right. The Gandor will now head for the Far East Branch's base.
All hands, Level 2 battle stations.
